links.outcome: Spine surgeon ratings of LLM answers to patient FAQs on lumbar disc herniation
links.effect: 27.2% excellent, 43.9% satisfactory with minimal clarification, 18.3% satisfactory with moderate clarification, 10.6% unsatisfactory; inter-rater reliability not achieved.
links.quote: Out of the responses, 27.2% were excellent, 43.9% satisfactory with minimal clarification, 18.3% satisfactory with moderate clarification, and 10.6% unsatisfactory.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates responses generated by LLMs to FAQs on lumbar disc herniation via spine surgeon rating, but it only assesses raw model performance and does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
